output.explanation:
The central tree retains the four main responsibility groups while shrinking from 110 to 74 lines (32.7%) and from 8302 to 5245 characters (36.8%). Five peripheral trees expand conversation state, tool boundaries, child isolation, evidence validation, and retry ownership. The decomposition combines modular boundaries, invocation paths, resource lifetimes, and the data dependencies needed to produce revisions. Edges attach to specific concepts using 1-based raw lines. Positions were checked against actual tree dimensions; no trees overlap.

Source-grounded additions include 32 ms delta buffering, background-chat visibility, fixed native tool definitions versus refreshed MCP tools, retained binding tokens, child-relative token accounting, receipt caching before persistence, saved variant scopes, and Pi's restricted tool/resource configuration. These come from the pinned AgentChatService, AgentChatPanel, ChatDiagramTools, MappingChatMcpBinding, GenerationCanvasBridge, DiagramEditService, DiagramBatchService, PiAgentRuntime, PiDiagramEditRuntime, and validation sources inside context.json.

Correction: the seed says generation cleanup always runs. AgentChatService.finishGeneration saves the final child record before entering the sync try/finally (lines 330-336); a rejected save can bypass that cleanup. The child tree makes this boundary explicit. The bridge's normal port contract also does not imply support for every command: canvas-view list returns empty saved views, save acknowledges, and other view operations reject (generationCanvasBridge.ts:78-85). Saving a chat request ID before turn/start suppresses duplicate attempts but does not guarantee native execution.

Only the supplied point, source text, and seed were used as semantic evidence. Imported implementations such as the live canvas adapter, revision-store helpers, generateDiagram, and AgentDiagrammingSessionService are not pinned here. Their internal guarantees and concrete runtime wiring remain unverified; the diagrams show visible calls and contracts rather than inferred internals. Pi is the supplied DiagramGenerator implementation, distinct from Codex chat transport.

diagrams.ascii:
Agent Chat and Generation
|-- Persistent conversations: AgentChatPanel -> AgentChatService
|   |-- Panel owns tabs, drafts, references and model / effort / access controls
|   |   `-- Send / Read Canvas / Stop / Resume / Reload tools
|   |-- ChatStore retains sessions, thread IDs, items, settings and request IDs
|   |   |-- New chat -> thread/start with instructions and tool definitions
|   |   `-- Import -> thread/resume; preserve native instructions and history
|   |       `-- Reject active threads; imported chats start without canvas tools
|   |-- One active turn per conversation
|   |   |-- Capture canvas target and references; bind tools to that target
|   |   |-- Read Canvas supplies short context as read_canvas tool output
|   |   `-- Save request ID before turn/start to suppress duplicate starts
|   |-- StdioCodexConnection owns the Codex app-server process
|   |   |-- Initialize; correlate line-delimited JSON RPC; 30-second timeout
|   |   `-- Native events -> service updates -> EventSource / ChatStream -> panel
|   |       |-- Items, usage and buffered deltas update the transcript
|   |       `-- Questions / approvals -> answer -> native response
|   `-- Recovery: disconnect fails active chats; restart interrupts open work
|       `-- Unfinished generations become failed after server restart
|-- Bound canvas tools: native calls or MCP -> shared service dispatch
|   |-- MappingChatMcpBinding associates token, chat, target and read-only flag
|   |   `-- Active turn + registered tool required; idle reload refreshes MCP
|   |-- gen-alternatives -> child-generation workflow
|   `-- ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService
|       |-- edit / create / extend require write access and one document
|       |-- Resolve reference or node ID against one captured snapshot
|       |   `-- Check base revision and complete subtree selections
|       |-- submitDirect -> shared batch / revision workflow
|       |-- Context, views, projections and requested highlights
|       `-- Reuse prepared mutation arguments; changed retry -> conflict
|-- Independent alternatives: AgentChatService.genAlternatives
|   |-- Require writable parent, prior user message, source canvas and tools
|   |   `-- Reject nested generation from child chats
|   |-- Allocate run, candidate view IDs and child chat IDs
|   |   |-- Save child records and parent receipt before canvas-generation start
|   |   `-- Capture history, prompts, settings and optional AgentContext ID / hash
|   |-- Schedule candidates together; each owns one managed turn
|   |   |-- Saved context -> new thread + injected reference material
|   |   |-- Otherwise -> fork parent at captured turn boundary
|   |   `-- Clear inherited goal; give each child its own binding and controller
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge implements the CanvasSessionPort contract
|   |   |-- Construct isolated MappingDocumentController from captured history
|   |   |-- Serialize commands; check binding and mutation versions
|   |   |-- Cache receipts; persist exported history before returning mutations
|   |   `-- Delegate live targets; child command support is restricted
|   `-- Finish -> finished / cancelled / failed; save child metadata and history
|       |-- Publish finished history to candidate view; retry unavailable saves
|       `-- After child save, sync attempt's finally releases binding / controller
`-- Shared diagram revision workflow
    |-- DiagramBatchService captures one versioned snapshot per batch
    |   |-- Reject repeated edits of the same shared diagram
    |   |-- Run DiagramEditService sequentially; collect edits and creations
    |   `-- Apply one combined batch; receive version and unresolved edge IDs
    |-- DiagramEditService owns generation and installation for each request
    |   |-- Validate operation, template, context source, version and base
    |   |-- Resolve retained revisions into pinned ASCII or node excerpts
    |   |-- Context: supplied snapshot or matching diagram-owned evidence
    |   |-- Supplied ASCII -> submitStoredDiagramEdit
    |   |-- Generated ASCII -> generateDiagram helper using DiagramGenerator
    |   |   `-- PiDiagramEditRuntime is separate from Codex chat execution
    |   |       |-- Authenticated model + persisted session + captured context
    |   |       |-- submit_diagram_edit -> validation and correction loop
    |   |       `-- Return accepted candidate; dispose session on exit
    |   `-- Install: in-place revision / review variant / new diagrams
    |       `-- Create or extend placement: reread version; at most 3 attempts
    |-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit checks candidate content
    |   |-- Parse structure, ranges and mappings; enforce source-mapping mode
    |   |-- Strip continuity markers; each must identify one output node
    |   `-- Scoped Pi edits preserve structure kind and replacement boundaries
    `-- Application result governs completion and retry
        |-- Acknowledged -> completed; version mismatch -> conflict
        |-- Other errors -> failed, except uncertain application outcomes
        |   `-- awaiting-acknowledgement -> retry retained result without generation
        `-- Cancellation is accepted while generating, not after apply dispatch

Conversation state and event delivery
|-- AgentChatPanel owns browser interaction state
|   |-- Drafts and per-tab settings stay in component memory
|   |-- Model preference uses localStorage; tabs saved by cwd
|   |-- Active tab owns EventSource and ChatStream
|   |   `-- Session switch closes stream and disposes its buffer
|   `-- Other open running tabs refresh summaries every 2500 ms
|-- AgentChatService owns session coordination
|   |-- ChatStore list / save retains conversation records
|   |-- Private maps retain listeners, wire requests and in-flight work
|   |-- subscribe sends a snapshot before subsequent events
|   `-- Background chats: read-only, no canvas tools, hidden from list
|-- Native events -> receive -> reduceChatEvent -> listeners
|   |-- threadSessions routes by native thread ID
|   |-- Adjacent deltas with same item ID and kind are merged
|   |   |-- Flush after 32 ms or a text burst over 64000 characters
|   |   `-- Non-delta events and get() flush outstanding deltas
|   |-- Completion settles open items and pending interactions
|   `-- Permission answers grant accepted fields for one turn
|-- StdioCodexConnection owns transport resources
|   |-- Lazy start shares initialization; stderr is drained
|   |-- Process config selects total-token compaction thresholds
|   |   `-- Disables token budgets and experimental context management
|   `-- Process failure rejects pending RPCs and notifies subscribers
`-- Restart recovery loads persisted records
    |-- Clear pending / activity; interrupt unfinished items and chats
    `-- Earlier native imports get default full access once

Tool visibility, binding and target resolution
|-- AgentChatService guards entry to shared dispatch
|   |-- Native calls: registered tool, no namespace, active matching turn
|   `-- MCP calls: token -> chat; active tools; reject during reload
|-- MappingChatMcpBinding configures the mapping MCP subprocess
|   |-- Retains one token per chat; bind sets target and read-only flag
|   `-- clear clears the downstream binding; token map entry remains
|-- Idle reload preserves the thread and refreshes visibility
|   |-- Native dynamicTools remain fixed at thread/start
|   |-- Unsubscribe / resume with fresh tool-generation config
|   |-- Reload MCP; require every chat_<name> in server inventory
|   `-- Inject instruction to use chat_*; persist new definitions
|-- ChatDiagramTools prepares direct diagram operations
|   |-- Exactly one target selector: reference or nodeId
|   |-- All operations share canvas document and captured snapshot
|   |-- Resolve aliases; require current baseRevisionId
|   |-- Unanchored create accepts nodeId = canvas
|   |-- Selected nodes must form complete subtrees
|   |   |-- Find selected roots; expand each root to all members
|   |   `-- Expanded set must equal selection; single mode needs one root
|   `-- submitDirect receives prepared fields and a fresh internal ID
|-- Public capabilities route through the injected agent service
|   |-- Saved context tools; diagram-owned context prepare / read / delete
|   |-- Views, projections and highlight mutations
|   `-- Read-only access permits context reads and view list / read
`-- Run ownership remains private to ChatDiagramTools
    |-- Status / cancel require owners[runId] = current chat
    `-- Owner and preparation maps do not survive backend restart

Child generation: isolated state and publication
|-- Preparation retains reproducible inputs
|   |-- Child stores inputHistory separately from mutable history
|   |-- Saved context: resolvedSnapshot preferred over snapshot
|   `-- Fork boundary: before active parent turn, else last parent turn
|-- GenerationCanvasBridge.add owns one child controller
|   |-- Canvas ID also becomes document ID; history gets new contextId
|   |-- Initial version is 0; parent and siblings keep separate state
|   `-- Per-child queue orders reads and writes; rejection frees queue
|-- Child exposes a subset of CanvasSessionPort
|   |-- identity / context / document-state / read / snapshot
|   |-- apply / revision / batch / create / diagram-context / checkpoint
|   |-- canvas-view list returns empty saved views; save acknowledges
|   |   `-- Other view operations reject; no child fork management
|   `-- Unsupported methods reject; expired generation IDs never delegate
|-- Each mutation uses method + requestId as its receipt key
|   |-- Compare full command signature before reusing receipt
|   |-- Cache applied result BEFORE awaiting history persistence
|   `-- Identical retry persists again without repeating mutation
|-- Child usage excludes inherited token totals
|   |-- Require numeric last-request counters for all tracked keys
|   `-- Pin baseline = total - last; report max(0, total - baseline)
|-- finishGeneration retains result before publishing
|   |-- cancelled metadata or interrupted chat -> cancelled
|   |-- Otherwise idle -> finished; other chat states -> failed
|   |-- Save final child metadata and current history first
|   |   `-- Save rejection exits before the later cleanup finally
|   |-- Sync metadata; only finished children publish history
|   `-- Sync attempt finally clears binding, removes controller, unsubscribes
`-- Reconciliation and replay reuse retained records
    |-- generations() retries unsynced terminal children; reports pendingSave
    |-- Reconnect matches stable workspace ID and document uniquely for sync
    |-- Observer receives grouped children and parent; failures are logged
    |-- Rerun restores original child settings, tools and parent turn boundary
    `-- Replay captured history through genAlternatives; source must be open

Evidence dependencies and validated Pi output
|-- DiagramEditService resolves the edit's inputs
|   |-- Snapshot must match expectedVersion and current baseRevisionId
|   |-- Import exact retained revisions; resolve references by revision ID
|   |   |-- Whole diagram -> pinned ASCII
|   |   `-- Nodes -> checked range, known IDs, labels and excerpt
|   |-- Supplied AgentContext normalized with content hash
|   |   `-- Panel context must match llmSessionId unless saved-context case
|   `-- Automatic diagram-owned context only for generated edits
|       `-- Requires matching source fingerprint and no supplied context
|-- Variant refinement reads its saved head revision and scope
|   |-- Owner diagram must match; retain prior review revisions
|   `-- Omit new subtree targets; replace-mode must match saved scope
|-- DiagramGenerationRequest carries dependencies across the port
|   |-- Template/options + instruction + pinned prompt references
|   |-- Base diagram, connections, evidence, nodeRefs and editable ranges
|   `-- Options report progress, agent session and captured context
|-- PiDiagramEditRuntime extends PiAgentRuntime
|   |-- Require enabled runtime and configured openai-codex authentication
|   |-- Model selection: environment override or default model ID
|   |-- Resolve AgentContext sources, then append messages to disk session
|   |-- Disable automatic context files, skills, extensions and templates
|   `-- Expose only submit_diagram_edit; prompt uses captured inputs
|-- createValidatedSubmission governs acceptance
|   |-- Rejected validation -> correction text, accepted=false, continue
|   |-- Accepted -> retain candidate, accepted=true, terminate=true
|   `-- Prompt ends without acceptance -> generation fails
|-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit checks the returned candidate
|   |-- Mapping mode off forbids nonempty mappings
|   |-- Mapping mode on requires mappings; empty array is allowed
|   |-- Reject blank text, CR and tabs; build and validate content
|   |-- Continuity correspondence must identify one output node per marker
|   `-- Scoped Pi validation also checks kind and replacement boundaries
`-- Return and release
    |-- Revalidate accepted candidate; preserve base source and evidence
    |-- Capture context only when llmSessionId is supplied
    `-- Finally detach abort listener, unsubscribe, dispose and untrack

Retry identities and application ownership
|-- Conversation start: durable requestIds
|   |-- Panel retains exact request body after a lost response
|   |-- Service saves request ID before native turn/start
|   `-- Duplicate ID returns without starting; execution is not guaranteed
|-- Child generation request: durable parent receipt
|   |-- Signature covers input, source and replay checkpoint if present
|   `-- Same ID returns receipt or saved error; changed arguments reject
|-- Tool preparation: volatile per-chat request maps
|   |-- Reuse captured arguments and internal mutation ID
|   |-- Preparation failure evicts entry so preparation can retry
|   `-- Edit and other mutation caches cap at 500 entries each
|-- DiagramBatchService owns one combined application
|   |-- Each child edit sees captured snapshot; extra revisions need same version
|   |-- Child apply/create collect results for one combined live batch
|   |-- Auto-placed creations accumulate width plus 6 columns
|   `-- Final receipt updates each result's document version
|-- DiagramEditService owns retained revision / variants / creations
|   |-- In-place application sends original version and base revision
|   |-- Standalone creation rereads latest snapshot for placement
|   |   `-- Retry VERSION_CONFLICT for at most 3 total attempts
|   `-- Batch collection retains the batch's original version
|-- Edit and batch application errors
|   |-- CANVAS_TIMEOUT / CANVAS_UNAVAILABLE / PERSISTENCE_PENDING
|   |   `-- Only while applying -> awaiting-acknowledgement
|   |-- Identical start retry reinstalls retained output, without model call
|   `-- Version conflict -> conflict; remaining errors -> failed
`-- Cancellation has an ownership boundary
    |-- Generating edit aborts; generating batch cancels its current child
    |-- Applying work cannot be labelled cancelled by cancel()
    `-- Parent chat interrupt also cancels its running child generations
